items.title: Citi Sees $11 Billion Optical Networking Boom Driven By Google, Nvidia
items.summary: With investors anticipating the next-gen GPU platform for Nvidia stock, Citi forecasts an $11 billion optical switching market by 2030.

items.title: AI Trade Picks Up Again as Investors Pile Back Into Stocks
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence rally looked set to restart on Friday, as a drop in bond yields gave risk assets a boost. Glassmaker Corning, optical networking companies Coherent and Lumentum, server maker Dell, and flash-memory product supplier Sandisk were all rallying ahead of the opening bell.

items.title: LITE Stock Has Run 450% In 12 Months: Ritholtz Wealth CEO Thinks There Is Room For More
items.summary: AI infrastructure demand continues to strengthen the optical networking growth story, according to Josh Brown.

items.title: Coherent Has Ripped 59% in 2026: Is It Too Late to Buy COHR Stock Now?
items.summary: Coherent stock has surged nearly 60% in 2026 riding the AI data center optical boom, yet its closest peers have lapped it twice over, raising a question the price chart alone cannot answer.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Rides on AI Boom: Can It Beat LITE and FN?
items.summary: AAOI is riding on AI-driven data-center demand as 800G sales surge, 1.6T orders top $200M, and manufacturing capacity expands to support growth.

items.title: AI Data Center Boom Faces This 'Fundamental Trade-Off' With China
items.summary: The U.S. can speed-run its AI data center boom or it can secure supply chains, but it "can't have it both ways."

items.title: Chips to Bots: Qualcomm’s Agentic AI Breakout
items.summary: Qualcomm is expanding beyond smartphones with new 2nm chips, the PickNik Robotics acquisition, and data center interconnect deals, while analysts hold a $204 price target amid Hold ratings.

items.title: Lumentum Shares Are Up After an AI Optical Tech Partnership With Corning and Qualcomm. What This Means for LITE Stock.
items.summary: Lumentum shares rose after it announced an AI optical connectivity demonstration with Corning and Qualcomm at ECOC 2026, pairing its VCSEL lasers with high-density chip-to-chip links.
